$$

$$
a+\lfloor a\rfloor=b+\lfloor b\rfloor .

If $a\neq b$, then $a$ and $b$ are in different intervals $[n, n+1)$ and $[n+1, n+2)$, respectively. In either case, $a+\lfloor a\rfloor=b+\lfloor b\rfloor$ is true. Therefore, $a=b$.
